goal: Take one of the fossils from the deepest floor of Mt. Moon

subgoals.goal_text: Heal the party at the Mt. Moon Pokemon Center before entering the cave to ensure maximum HP and PP.
Navigate through the first floor to reach the first basement
Navigate through the first basement to reach the deepest floor (B2F)
Find and pick up either the Helix Fossil or the Dome Fossil on the deepest floor
